name: Brann Bronzebeard
summary: In southern Silithus, Brann Bronzebeard's companions wait for word from his latest expedition. The youngest brother of King Magni and Muradin is famed across Azeroth as an explorer, archaeologist, and founding leader of the explorers' league. His search for titan ruins and ancient history has led him deep into the deadly wastes.

sections.title: A Royal Wanderer
sections.body: Brann Bronzebeard chose the open wilds while his eldest brother Magni ruled Ironforge and Muradin served on the front lines. A veteran of the Second War, Brann turned his strength toward the forgotten past when peace came. As a leader of the explorers' league, he charted the Eastern Kingdoms, from Elwynn Forest to the jungles of Zul'Gurub. Then he crossed the Great Sea to seek the mysteries of ancient Kalimdor.

sections.title: Trouble in Silithus
sections.body:
Reports from the Cenarion Circle spoke of the Old God C'Thun and the slumbering qiraji swarm. They drew Brann south to Silithus, where he founded Bronzebeard Encampment with Rutgar Glyphshaper and Frankal Stonebridge.

The priestess Natalia Mar'alith had gone mad from horrors whispering in the shifting sands. She raided their camp and demanded Brann lead them back into Hive'Regal. Brann refused, and she attacked. He, his crew, and his pet ape Glibb barely fought her off.

sections.title: Beyond the Scarab Wall
sections.body:
Brann Bronzebeard set his sights on the sealed kingdom behind the Scarab Wall. He found a hidden tunnel beneath the ancient barrier and entered alone. Before leaving, he gave Glibb to the expedition with strict written orders: plenty of food, water, and affectionate hugs.

Rutgar Glyphshaper and Frankal Stonebridge remain in southern Silithus. They wait for word from Brann within the silithid hives.

faq.answer: Brann Bronzebeard is the youngest brother of King Magni Bronzebeard of Ironforge and a co-founder and driving force of the dwarven explorers' league. A renowned archaeologist and cartographer, he travels Azeroth's most dangerous frontiers in search of titan artifacts and lost civilizations.

faq.q: Where is Brann Bronzebeard right now?
faq.answer: Brann Bronzebeard's trail leads to Silithus, where Rutgar Glyphshaper and Frankal Stonebridge keep Bronzebeard Encampment. They may know about his latest expedition.

faq.q: What happened to his camp in Silithus?
faq.answer: Rutgar Glyphshaper and Frankal Stonebridge have troubling news about Brann Bronzebeard's expedition. Speak with them to learn what happened at the camp.
Glibb is Brann Bronzebeard's companion ape. He is staying with the explorers at Bronzebeard Encampment in Silithus.

faq.q: Did Brann fight in the Second War?
aliases: was brann in the alliance army
faq.answer: Yes. Brann Bronzebeard is a veteran of the Second War. In peacetime, he turned his strength toward uncovering the forgotten past.

faq.q: Why is Brann interested in Silithus?
aliases: why did brann go to silithus
faq.answer: Reports from the Cenarion Circle about the Old God C'Thun and the slumbering qiraji swarm drew Brann Bronzebeard to Silithus. His interest in titan history led him to seek a way beyond the sealed Scarab Wall and inspect the ruins firsthand.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see Brann Bronzebeard's passion for uncovering the roots of his people's titan heritage. He is the youngest brother of King Magni.
As an Alliance member, you benefit from the knowledge and archives Brann Bronzebeard's expeditions build. His habit of vanishing without a trace often frustrates Ironforge's leadership.
